description: This file defines the class pImage, a core component for image rendering and manipulation within the pChart library. It extends the pDraw class and provides methods for creating images, setting properties, rendering, and handling image maps and shadows. The file is part of a charting library used for generating graphical charts and images.

classes.name: pImage
classes.description: Core image handling class for pChart library, providing image creation, rendering, and auxiliary features like shadows, image maps, and text handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing image dimensions, dataset, and background transparency.

methods.name: setShadow
methods.description: Enables or disables shadow rendering with specified properties.

methods.name: setGraphArea
methods.description: Defines the drawable graph area within the image.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the image.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the image.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Outputs the image to a file.

methods.name: stroke
methods.description: Outputs the image directly to the browser as PNG.

methods.name: autoOutput
methods.description: Automatically outputs the image based on execution context (CLI or web).

methods.name: getLength
methods.description: Calculates the distance between two points.

methods.name: getAngle
methods.description: Calculates the orientation angle between two points.

methods.name: getTextBox
methods.description: Calculates the bounding box of a text string at given position, font, and angle.

methods.name: setFontProperties
methods.description: Sets font color, name, and size for subsequent text rendering.

methods.name: getFirstDecimal
methods.description: Extracts the first decimal digit of a numeric value.

methods.name: setDataSet
methods.description: Attaches a dataset to the image object.

methods.name: printDataSet
methods.description: Prints the attached dataset for debugging.

methods.name: initialiseImageMap
methods.description: Initializes image map handling with session or file storage modes.

methods.name: addToImageMap
methods.description: Adds a clickable zone to the image map.

methods.name: removeVOIDFromArray
methods.description: Removes VOID entries from a dataset array.

methods.name: replaceImageMapTitle
methods.description: Replaces the title of a zone in the image map.

methods.name: replaceImageMapValues
methods.description: Replaces values within image map zones.

methods.name: dumpImageMap
methods.description: Outputs the image map as HTML and terminates script execution.

methods.name: toHTMLColor
methods.description: Converts RGB values to HTML color code.

methods.name: reversePlots
methods.description: Reverses an array of plot points.

methods.name: drawAreaMirror
methods.description: Creates a mirror reflection area effect on the image.
